_doc: What the Windows gate queue checks for this candidate. Edited by the pilot for each candidate; read by the PC queue script. No machine paths here. From candidate 60 the gate judges what the player sees: the default traffic, which is the legacy one (MassTraffic runs only with -Traffic=mass). The 'blocking' criteria are read on the blocking passes; everything under 'informative_mass' is measured and reported on the MassTraffic passes but never fails the gate, and never stops it. Those criteria become blocking again only for switching the default traffic to mass, once a whole gate passes them (ADR-0015).

blocking.errors_scope: every blocking pass; Error lines of the MassTraffic passes are counted in informative_mass

_legacy_note: Legacy counts come from the line 'traffic cars t=...s:' every 10 s (default and gtarun passes). legacy_lying_max is read on its 'lying=' field. legacy_moving_upright_percent_120_300_min is judged on its share 'upright: P %' (the legacy traffic wants fewer cars than MassTraffic's 120, so a share, not a count), mean of 120 to 300 s; left empty on purpose: the pilot sets it from the measure of gate 59, not before. gtarun_crash_ok: step 12 (crash) of the gtarun pass must end ok on a 'legacy traffic car', so the player does not drive through the traffic. A missing count line or crash line on a blocking pass fails the gate. From candidate 64 (thresholds set by the pilot from the measure of 616cff8, 22/11): within 150 m of the player, the mean of 'within 150 m=N (moving M' must be at least 8 in the gtarun pass from 30 s to 'GTARun done' (the theft and the flight; measured 9.4) and at least 3 in the default pass after 30 s (measured 4.2). Target 15 in the flight, not blocking.

base_map._doc: Roadmap V6 3.4: a candidate's map is the frozen base map plus the steps of pre_gate replayed in order, never the map left by the previous gate. The runner restores the base (md5 checked before and after) before the first step that saves the map. The base is refrozen only after a passed gate with its video watched.

_gate_kind_doc: Roadmap V6 3.3. Short gate (each candidate, moves next): build, package, the default pass, the GTARun pass, the filmed run; judged on the 10-point grid read on the video, the blocking numbers and errors. Full gate (once a day on the last head that passed a short gate, moves main): today's passes without the MassTraffic ones, plus next_full_gate_extra_passes. A number missed by less than 10 % does not fail a gate on its own: the grid decides.
